newsitem.title: UK: Hitachi Credit (UK) plans LSE float in July.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Credit (UK) plans LSE float in July.

text.p: Credit finance company Hitachi Credit (UK) Plc (HCUK) said on Tuesday it expected to raise about 20 million stg from its planned flotation on the London Stock Exchange in July.
The company said it hoped to place around 14.8 million shares at 135p each, which would value HCUK at approximately 57.3 million stg.

HCUK said the float would strengthen the balance sheet by the reducing gearing and would provide a more solid platform from which to expand the company's businesses through organic growth and acquisitions.
The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Hitachi Credit Corporation of Japan which is in turn 52.4 percent owned by Hitachi Ltd.
HCUK offers a range of financial products to both the business and personal sectors in the UK.
The placing is being underwritten by brokerage UBS and dealings in the shares are expected to begin on July 15.
